question: According to what measurement should the beautiful image be made?
premises: The image should be beautiful in all limbs.
A specific measurement standard is prescribed.
The standard is ten tālas measured by the little finger.
inference: One should make the image beautiful in all limbs according to the ten-tāla measure of the little finger.
plain_english: One should make it beautiful in all its limbs, according to the ten-tāla measure of the little finger.
